classification.summary: The YYDS distribution contract's withdrawReturnAmountByReferral/ByMerchant/ByConsumer paid out YYDS to any caller without checking entitlement, and the attacker dumped the resulting YYDS into the YYDS/USDT pair inside a flash swap.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/yyds.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: distribution contract 0x970A76aEa6a0D531096b566340C0de9B027dd39D created 2022-05-24T08:02:33Z by 0x17304f0e5a5b42242f0118715b8c28cfe987373b, unrelated to attack sender 0xed850799cf22b66cb4911539425f8a41423d0933; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Note that the PoC's other target 0xe70cdd37667cdDF52CabF3EdabE377C58FaE99e9 was deployed by the attacker themselves and is therefore not the victim. Loss verified onchain: 742,286.27 USDT left the YYDS/USDT pair 0xd5cA448b06F8eb5acC6921502e33912FA3D63b12 to the attacker in the exploit transaction.
